hero.title: How People works, in 1 minute.
hero.lead: A wallet, one check that you are a person, and then you can launch, mint, swap or vote. No code and no crypto background.

steps.title: What a regular person actually does
steps.lead: This is the whole onboarding. Everything else on this page is detail for the curious.

items.title: Get a wallet in 30 seconds
items.body: Open the site on your phone or in a browser and create a wallet — a non-custodial 12-word phrase (keys stay on your device), or a quicker Google sign-in with an encrypted, cloud-synced key.
items.note: No app store, no seed-phrase homework.

items.title: Prove you are a human
items.body: Verify once with a Telegram phone number or a Human Passport. One person, one account — that is what keeps bots from farming the community pool.

items.title: Launch, mint, swap or vote
items.body: Start a token for your community, mint club cards, trade in the token/PPL pool, or vote on where the community pool goes.
items.note: Each action is a normal button, not a command line.

supply.title: One billion PPL, and no surprises
supply.lead: The supply is fixed at genesis. Nothing is minted on a schedule behind your back.
supply.noNewCoins: Years 1–4: 0% new coins. Inflation parameters are pinned to zero in the chain genesis.
supply.year5: From year 5: at most 2% a year, and only if the community votes for it.
supply.donutNote: Sums to 100% of the one billion PPL. The community bucket unlocks linearly over six years; the treasury and locked liquidity are not circulating.

validators.title: Who runs the network, and who pays for it
validators.lead: Validators keep the chain running. They are paid from their own pool, plus a share of every fee.
validators.scheduleNote: Years 1–4 release 60M, 50M, 50M and 40M PPL from the 200M pool. Nothing is minted to pay for it.
validators.feeNote: On top of the schedule, validators receive 30% of every network fee, split every block.

fees.title: Where every fee goes
fees.lead: Every network fee is paid in PPL and split the same way, every time.
fees.note: Nothing is burned: the burn line is 0%. Fractional fees follow the same split.

launch.title: What happens when you launch
launch.lead: Three rules are enforced by the contracts, not by us being nice.

points.title: The curve prices it from the first trade
points.body: There is no private round and no preset price. The token starts on a bonding curve, so the very first buy sets the price everyone else sees.

points.title: 10% goes to that token's community pool
points.body: Every standard launch sends 10% of its supply to the token's own community pool. It is never mixed with network fees.

points.title: The creator's share vests over 180 days
points.body: 10% of the creator allocation is liquid at creation, the remaining 90% unlocks linearly over 180 days. No dump on day one.

launch.curveNote: Illustrative shape of the curve — this is how the mechanism works, not a price forecast.

founders.title: Be early, and bring your people
founders.lead: Founder numbers are still open. Two referral levels, and only active people count.
bullets: Two levels: you earn from your invitees, and a smaller share from theirs.
Inactive accounts earn nothing — a hundred fake accounts earn a hundred times zero.
Rewards vest: 10% liquid at once, the rest in weekly slices over 52 weeks.

items.a: No. This is a public testnet. The tokens and balances here are for testing and carry no value.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Creating a wallet, launching a token, minting club cards and voting are buttons in the interface. Contracts come from audited OpenZeppelin templates.
30% to validators, 25% to the community pool, 20% to the treasury, 10% to liquidity, 15% to the Growth Pool and 0% burned.
Not in years 1–4 — the chain genesis pins inflation to zero. From year 5, at most 2% a year and only by community vote.

items.q: Is this a promise of income?
items.a: No. Rewards are not fixed: no activity, no rewards. Token prices can go up, down, or to zero. This is participation in a network, not an investment.

cta.title: That is the whole idea
cta.body: Try it on the testnet, or read the details in the docs first.
